name: XL Holdings Berhad
overview: XL Holdings Berhad 今年通过 XL Retail Sdn. Bhd. 收购了 34 家 GIANT Mini 迷你超市的资产，并提议将业务多元化至杂货零售和批发业务。此外，公司通过发行新股（ESOS 和融资活动）筹集资金，并涉及多项关联方交易。最新一季营收同比增长 151.0%，但净利润同比下降 40.7%。
overview_en: XL Holdings Berhad acquired the assets of 34 GIANT Mini minimarts through XL Retail Sdn. Bhd. this year and proposed to diversify into grocery retailing and wholesaling. The company also raised funds via new share issuances (ESOS and fund-raising exercises) and engaged in various recurrent related party transactions. Latest quarterly revenue grew 151.0% year-on-year, while net profit declined 40.7% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司提议将业务多元化至杂货零售和批发业务，并通过 XL Retail 收购 34 家 GIANT Mini 迷你超市资产。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to diversify into grocery retailing and wholesaling and acquired the assets of 34 GIANT Mini minimarts through XL Retail.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DIVERSIFICATION OF THE EXISTING BUSINESS OF XL HOLDINGS BERHAD AND ITS SUBSIDIARIES TO
actions.text: 提议将现有业务多元化至包括杂货零售和批发业务。
actions.text_en: Proposed diversification of existing business to include retailing and wholesaling grocery business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述收购于 2026 年 5 月 31 日完成，买方保留 RM340,000 直至卖方完成某些交割后义务。
actions.text_en: The acquisition was completed on 31 May 2026, with the purchaser retaining RM340,000 until the seller completes certain post-completion obligations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: XL Retail Sdn. Bhd. 与 Jutaria Gemilang Sdn. Bhd. 签订资产购买协议，收购 34 家 GIANT Mini 迷你超市的租赁权、家具、设备及库存等资产。
actions.text_en: XL Retail Sdn. Bhd. entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Jutaria Gemilang Sdn. Bhd. to acquire tenancies, furnishings, equipment, and inventories of 34 GIANT Mini minimarts.
